drupal/admin_toolbar.description: Issue #3385337 / MR !209 — defer menu link rebuilds in admin_toolbar_tools so a programmatic import that creates many bundles in one request triggers ONE rebuild at request termination instead of one per entity. Without this, dc_import's first publish to a fresh tenant times out at 120s when admin_toolbar_tools_entity_insert calls MenuLinkManager::rebuild() on every paragraph type save. Drop this entry once admin_toolbar 3.x merges the MR.
